method: Prior six-regime conditional probabilities, subdivide by directional adverse return and side volume vs preceding equal nonoverlap window. States 0 volume up adverse return down,1 volume up adverse return not down but efficiency down,2 volume up other,3 volume not up adverse return down,4 current reversal or flat,5 other. 30 pseudo counts. Spot/futures 1/2/3d and mean of six probabilities. Pre2025 train, 2025 threshold and variant selection, H1 exploratory, 15d purge, 3d cooldown.
